prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: transparent environmental sprite sheet for a top-down fairy woodland game. Reference input is ONLY material, palette and rendering style; DO NOT repeat the frame/ring composition. Make a clean 2 by 2 sheet of FOUR COMPLETELY SEPARATE finite terrain formations, one centered in each equal cell. Generous transparent gaps (at least 60 pixels) between all four pieces and all edges. Each formation MUST have fully drawn rounded natural ENDS: no chopped vertical or horizontal cut faces, no square image crops, no infinitely tiling strips. Every piece can stand alone on a grass map, and can also slightly overlap another piece by its rounded end. Do not draw a whole frame. No connecting the four pieces! Fixed high top-down orthographic camera matching reference, never an isometric diamond. Refined matte pixel-painted art, readable texture, not coarse pixel blocks, not glossy 3D. Global gentle warm top-left lighting on all four pieces; no cast shadows floating far from object. Truly transparent background with no ground plate, checkerboard, text, labels, outlines, UI, characters, droplets or houses. Large 1536x1536 or larger canvas, comfortably fit everything. Subject: interlocking small broadleaf oak tree crowns, moss/olive green with warm leaf highlights, little dark branch visible deep beneath leaves, no exposed trunks or roots. The four finite groves: upper-left a long HORIZONTAL row of 4 naturally nesting crowns, with small rounded crowns rounding off both ends; upper-right a shorter HORIZONTAL row of 3 crowns, another silhouette; lower-left a long VERTICAL north-south row of 4 crowns, showing overhead canopy not a standing tree, both ends rounded; lower-right a shorter VERTICAL row of 3 crowns. Consistent leaf density and thickness across pieces. They are wild natural woodland thickets, not trimmed garden hedges.
